name: flowpilot-ai
description: AI-powered Software Quality Engineering agent. Don't just test your app. Walk through it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,dashboard,demo" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/dashboard" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/demo-shop"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/agent-core && npm run build --workspace=packages/browser-runner && npm run build --workspace=packages/flow-architect && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=apps/dashboard && npm run build --workspace=apps/demo-shop
scripts.clean: find . -name 'dist' -not -path '**/node_modules/**' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name 'node_modules' -maxdepth 2 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; echo 'Clean done'
